name: OpenClawDir
requirements: Niche directory for OpenClaw (AI agent) skills, plugins/extensions, and jobs - only relevant if you ship an OpenClaw plugin or skill
Google sign-in required: 'You need to sign in to submit a plugin'; Continue with Google is the only auth shown
Per pricing page: 'Submitting skills and plugins is free. Only job postings and featured placements require payment.'
preparation: Plugin/skill name, description, install/repo URL, and category (Tools, Channels, Integration, Voice, General, Finance for plugins; Automation, Productivity, Browser, etc. for skills)
workflow: Listing goes into the plugins/skills directory; optional $49 'Featured Plugin' for 30-day homepage/priority placement
watchFor: Very niche fit: not affiliated with OpenClaw itself ('Not affiliated with OpenClaw' in footer)
Paid items exist and are unrelated to listing: Job $99, Featured Job $199, Featured Plugin $49 - all one-time, 30-day placements
Only Google OAuth offered - no email signup
countsAsLive: The plugin/skill appears in the openclawdir.com directory under /plugins or /skills with its own entry.
unknowns: Exact submit form fields behind sign-in
